rules.rule_name: Detect and Report Pending Authorization Summary Read Failure
rules.rule_description: When reading a Pending Authorization Summary record from the database returns an unexpected result (neither a successful read nor an end-of-database condition), the program must capture and display the failure status and the associated key feedback area before triggering abnormal termination.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reading Pending Auth Summary Record Failed
Display Auth Sum GN Failed
and Key Feedback Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is sequentially reading Pending Authorization Summary records from the database, and a read attempt has just been completed
acceptance_criteria.When: The result of the read is neither a successful retrieval (blank status) nor an end-of-database indicator, meaning an unexpected failure has occurred while reading the Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'AUTH SUM GN FAILED' along with the specific failure status returned, and also display the 'KEY FEEDBACK AREA' along with the key feedback value to identify which record caused the failure, then invoke the abnormal termination process

rules.rule_name: Detect and Report Pending Authorization Detail Read Failure
rules.rule_description: When reading a Pending Authorization Detail (child) record under a parent Summary record returns an unexpected result (neither a successful read nor a no-more-children condition), the program must capture and display the failure status and key feedback area before triggering abnormal termination.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reading Pending Auth Detail Record Failed
Display GNP Call Failed
and Key Feedback Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is reading Pending Authorization Detail records associated with a specific Pending Authorization Summary record, and a read attempt has just been completed
acceptance_criteria.When: The result of the read is neither a successful retrieval (blank status) nor a no-more-children indicator, meaning an unexpected failure has occurred while reading the Pending Authorization Detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'GNP CALL FAILED' along with the specific failure status returned, and also display the 'KFB AREA IN CHILD' along with the key feedback value to identify which child record caused the failure, then invoke the abnormal termination process

rules.rule_name: Detect and Report Parent Summary Output Write Failure
rules.rule_description: When writing a Pending Authorization Summary record to the parent output file returns an unsuccessful result, the program must capture and display the failure status and key feedback area before triggering abnormal termination.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Writing Summary Record to Parent Output Failed
Display GSAM Parent Fail
and Key Feedback Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has validated that the Pending Authorization Summary record has a numeric Account ID and is attempting to write it to the parent output file
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation to the parent output file does not complete successfully (status is not blank), meaning the Summary record could not be stored in the output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'GSAM PARENT FAIL' along with the specific failure status returned, and also display the 'KFB AREA IN GSAM' along with the key feedback value to identify the record that failed to write, then invoke the abnormal termination process

rules.rule_name: Detect and Report Child Detail Output Write Failure
rules.rule_description: When writing a Pending Authorization Detail record to the child output file returns an unsuccessful result, the program must capture and display the failure status and key feedback area before triggering abnormal termination.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Writing Detail Record to Child Output Failed
Display GSAM Child Fail
and Key Feedback Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has successfully read a Pending Authorization Detail record and is attempting to write it to the child output file
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation to the child output file does not complete successfully (status is not blank), meaning the Detail record could not be stored in the output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'GSAM PARENT FAIL' along with the specific failure status returned, and also display the 'KFB AREA IN GSAM' along with the key feedback value to identify the record that failed to write, then invoke the abnormal termination process

rules.rule_name: Signal Abnormal Program Termination with Return Code 16
rules.rule_description: When any critical failure occurs during the processing of Pending Authorization Summary or Detail records — whether during reading from the database or writing to output files — the program must announce its abnormal end and communicate a failure signal of 16 to the calling environment before stopping.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Program Abnormal End Message DBUNLDGS ABENDING
Set Return Code to 16 to Signal Abnormal Program Termination

acceptance_criteria.Given: A critical failure has been detected during any stage of processing — reading Pending Authorization Summary records, reading Pending Authorization Detail records, writing to the parent output file, or writing to the child output file — and the specific failure details have already been displayed
acceptance_criteria.When: The abnormal termination process is invoked as a result of any of these critical failures
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'DBUNLDGS ABENDING ...' to announce the abnormal end, set the program return code to 16 to signal a critical failure to the calling environment, and immediately stop all processing

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The DBUNLDGS program has been invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must capture today's calendar date (CURRENT-DATE) and Julian date (CURRENT-YYDDD), display the program name 'DBUNLDGS', display a separator banner, and display today's calendar date as the processing date

all_rules.Rule_Name: Program Initialization and Start Banner Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: At program startup, the system captures the current calendar date and Julian date, and displays a start banner to confirm the program has begun execution.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is in the main processing loop and has not yet reached the end of the Pending Authorization Summary database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Get Next (GN) call is issued against the PAUTBPCB database using ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA (unqualified segment search argument)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next available Pending Authorization Summary record (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY segment) is retrieved from the PAUTSUM0 IMS segment and made available for further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Read of Pending Authorization Summary Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program sequentially retrieves each Pending Authorization Summary record (root/parent segment) from the IMS database one at a time using an unqualified Get Next call.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) extracted from the summary record is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If PA-ACCT-ID is numeric, the record is eligible for output processing and child detail retrieval; if PA-ACCT-ID is NOT numeric, the record is skipped entirely — no parent record is written to the output file and no child detail records are read or written for that summary

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Numeric Validation for Authorization Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before writing a Pending Authorization Summary record to the output file, the Account ID must be validated to ensure it contains only numeric characters. Records with non-numeric Account IDs are silently skipped with no output written.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved and its Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) has been confirmed as numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.When: An Insert (ISRT) call is issued to write the PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY record to the PASFLPCB GSAM parent output dataset
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Pending Authorization Summary record is successfully written to the PASFLPCB parent GSAM output file; if the insert fails for any reason, the program must terminate abnormally with return code 16 and display the error status and key feedback area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Pending Authorization Summary to Parent Output File
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each valid Pending Authorization Summary record (with a numeric Account ID) is written to the dedicated parent GSAM output file (PASFLPCB) as a root segment insert.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Pending Authorization Summary (parent) record has been written to the output file and the child processing loop is active
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Get Next within Parent (GNP) call is issued against the PAUTBPCB database using CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA (unqualified segment search argument) to retrieve PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS segments
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next available Pending Authorization Detail record (PAUTDTL1 IMS segment) belonging to the current parent is retrieved and made available for output writing; the retrieval is scoped strictly to child segments of the current parent summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Read of Pending Authorization Detail Records for Current Parent
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each valid parent Authorization Summary record, all associated child Authorization Detail records are retrieved sequentially using a Get Next within Parent call, ensuring only detail records belonging to the current parent are read.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved for the current parent summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: An Insert (ISRT) call is issued to write the PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS record to the PADFLPCB GSAM child output dataset
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully written to the PADFLPCB child GSAM output file; if the insert fails for any reason, the program must terminate abnormally with return code 16 and display the error status and key feedback area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Pending Authorization Detail to Child Output File
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each successfully retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record is written to the dedicated child GSAM output file (PADFLPCB), maintaining separation between parent summary and child detail output.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary or Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved from the database (IMS status equals spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The successful read is confirmed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total summary records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) must be incremented by 1, AND the authorization summary processed count (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) must also be incremented by 1 — this applies to both parent summary reads and child detail reads

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Summary and Detail Record Processing Counters
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each successfully read record — whether a parent Authorization Summary or a child Authorization Detail — is counted toward both the total records read counter and the total authorization summary processed counter.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Get Next (GN) call has been issued to read the next Pending Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database returns a 'GB' (end-of-database) status on the PAUTBPCB PCB
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The end-of-authorization-database flag (END-OF-AUTHDB) must be set to TRUE, the root segment end flag (WS-END-OF-ROOT-SEG) must be set to 'Y', and the main processing loop must terminate — no further summary records are read

all_rules.Rule_Name: End of Authorization Summary Database Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the database signals that no more Pending Authorization Summary records exist, the program sets an end-of-database flag and stops further reading, transitioning to file closure.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Get Next within Parent (GNP) call has been issued to read the next Pending Authorization Detail record for the current parent
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database returns a 'GE' (no more segments within parent) status on the PAUTBPCB PCB
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The child segment end flag (WS-END-OF-CHILD-SEG) must be set to 'Y', a display message confirming the child segment end flag value must be shown, and the child detail processing loop must terminate — processing returns to read the next parent summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: End of Child Detail Segments Detection for Current Parent
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the database signals that no more child Authorization Detail records exist for the current parent summary, the child processing loop is terminated and processing advances to the next parent summary record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All Pending Authorization Summary records have been processed and the end-of-database condition has been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program exits the main processing loop
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'CLOSING THE FILE' to confirm completion, and then terminate normally

all_rules.Rule_Name: Output File Closure and Completion Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all Pending Authorization Summary and Detail records have been processed, the program displays a completion message before ending normally.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has issued a database read call (GN for summary or GNP for detail) or a GSAM file write call (ISRT for parent or child)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The returned status is not a recognized expected status — specifically: not spaces (success) and not 'GB' (end-of-database) for summary reads; not spaces (success) and not 'GE' (end-of-children) for detail reads; not spaces (success) for GSAM write operations
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must display 'DBUNLDGS ABENDING...', display the specific error status code and the key feedback area (PAUT-KEYFB, PASFL-KEYFB, or PADFL-KEYFB as applicable) for diagnostic purposes, set the return code to 16, and terminate immediately without processing any further records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Abnormal Termination on Unexpected Database or File Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: If any unexpected error occurs while reading Authorization Summary records, reading Authorization Detail records, or writing to either output file, the program must terminate abnormally with a specific return code and display diagnostic information.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The DBUNLDGS program has been invoked and is beginning its initialization phase
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program starts its initialization routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current calendar date is captured and stored in CURRENT-DATE to serve as the processing date reference for the entire program run

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Current Calendar Date at Program Start
all_rules.Rule_Description: At program initialization, the system captures the current calendar date to establish the processing date context for the DBUNLDGS unload run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The DBUNLDGS program has been invoked and is beginning its initialization phase
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program starts its initialization routine immediately after capturing the calendar date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current Julian date in YYDDD format is captured and stored in CURRENT-YYDDD to serve as an additional processing date reference for the program run

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Current Julian Date at Program Start
all_rules.Rule_Description: At program initialization, the system captures the current Julian date in YYDDD format to establish the processing day context for the DBUNLDGS unload run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The DBUNLDGS program has captured the current calendar date and Julian date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program proceeds to log its start
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The processing log must display the message 'STARTING PROGRAM DBUNLDGS::' followed by a separator line '*-------------------------------------*' to clearly mark the start of the program execution in the log

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Program Start Banner to Processing Log
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the start of the DBUNLDGS program, a banner message is written to the processing log to mark the beginning of the authorization data unload process, providing a clear audit trail entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The DBUNLDGS program has displayed the program start banner and the current calendar date has been captured in CURRENT-DATE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program logs the processing date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The processing log must display the label 'TODAYS DATE            :' followed by the value of CURRENT-DATE, and a blank line must be written after the date entry to visually separate the initialization log entries from subsequent processing messages

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Today's Date to Processing Log
all_rules.Rule_Description: After displaying the program start banner, the system writes today's calendar date to the processing log so that the exact date of the authorization data unload run is permanently recorded for audit and traceability purposes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The DBUNLDGS program is actively processing Pending Authorization Summary records and has not yet reached the end of the database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program requests the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database using a sequential unqualified Get-Next (GN) retrieval against the PAUTSUM0 root segment
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next available Pending Authorization Summary record is retrieved from the database and made available for further processing, including counter updates and Account ID validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Retrieval of Pending Authorization Summary Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program sequentially retrieves the next available Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database (PAUTSUM0) using an unqualified Get-Next call, processing all records one at a time in database order.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database (retrieval status indicates success with no error condition)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program confirms the record was retrieved without error
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total summary records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) is incremented by 1, AND the authorization summary processed count (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is incremented by 1, AND the retrieved record data is copied to the output record area for further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Counters on Successful Summary Record Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time a Pending Authorization Summary record is successfully retrieved from the database, two running counters are incremented to track the total number of summary records read and the total number of authorization summaries processed during the program run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved and its counters have been incremented, AND the Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) has been extracted from the summary record into the root segment key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates whether the Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) contains only numeric characters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Account ID IS numeric: the program proceeds to write the summary record to the parent output file AND processes all associated child authorization detail records; If the Account ID is NOT numeric: the summary record is skipped entirely — it is not written to any output file and none of its associated child detail records are retrieved or written

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Account ID is Numeric Before Processing Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before a successfully retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record is written to the output file and its child detail records are processed, the Account ID field must be validated to ensure it contains only numeric characters. Records with non-numeric Account IDs are silently skipped — neither the summary nor any of its associated detail records are written to output.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has issued a sequential Get-Next request for the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database returns an end-of-database signal (status 'GB'), indicating there are no more Pending Authorization Summary records to process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The end-of-authorization-database flag (END-OF-AUTHDB) is set to TRUE, AND the end-of-root-segment flag (WS-END-OF-ROOT-SEG) is set to 'Y', which causes the main processing loop to terminate and the program to proceed to file closure

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect End of Pending Authorization Summary Database
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the database signals that there are no more Pending Authorization Summary records available to retrieve, the program recognizes this as the normal end-of-database condition and sets a flag to stop the main processing loop, allowing the program to proceed to file closure and termination.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has issued a sequential Get-Next request for the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database returns a status that is neither a successful retrieval (blank/spaces) nor a normal end-of-database condition ('GB'), indicating an unexpected error condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program displays the message 'AUTH SUM GN FAILED :' along with the error status code, AND displays the message 'KEY FEEDBACK AREA :' along with the key feedback area (PAUT-KEYFB) for diagnostic purposes, AND the program terminates abnormally with a return code of 16

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Abnormal Termination on Unexpected Summary Read Error
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the database returns any status other than a successful retrieval or a normal end-of-database condition when reading a Pending Authorization Summary record, the program treats this as an unrecoverable error, displays diagnostic information including the error status and key feedback area, and terminates abnormally.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the database AND its Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) has been confirmed to be numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID numeric validation passes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program proceeds to invoke the parent segment write process (3100-INSERT-PARENT-SEG-GSAM) to write the summary record to the GSAM parent output file, AND then resets the child segment end flag (WS-END-OF-CHILD-SEG), AND then enters the child detail record processing loop to retrieve and write all associated Pending Authorization Detail records for this summary

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Write Summary and Process Child Detail Records for Valid Account
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record passes the numeric Account ID validation, the program is directed to write the summary record to the parent output file and subsequently retrieve and write all associated child Pending Authorization Detail records, preserving the parent-child relationship in the output.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the Pending Authorization database, and the record contains an Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) value from the retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record is evaluated to determine whether it contains a valid numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Account ID is numeric, the Pending Authorization Summary record is considered valid and processing continues — the summary record is written to the parent output file and all associated Pending Authorization Detail records are retrieved and written to the child output file; If the Account ID is NOT numeric, the entire Pending Authorization Summary record is skipped without being written to any output file, and none of its associated Pending Authorization Detail records are retrieved or written, and processing moves directly to the next Pending Authorization Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Account ID is Numeric Before Processing Authorization Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record is retrieved from the database, the Account ID must be validated as numeric before the record and its associated child detail records are eligible for output processing. Records with non-numeric Account IDs are entirely skipped.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the authorization database and its Account ID has been validated as numeric
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to write the Pending Authorization Summary record as a root segment into the Parent GSAM sequential output dataset (PASFLPCB)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The complete Pending Authorization Summary record is inserted into the Parent GSAM output dataset as a root/parent segment, and processing continues to retrieve and write the associated child Authorization Detail records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Pending Authorization Summary Record to Parent Output Dataset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a valid Pending Authorization Summary record has been retrieved and its Account ID is confirmed as numeric, the system must insert the summary record into the Parent GSAM sequential output dataset to unload the root segment data for downstream consumption.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to insert the Pending Authorization Summary record into the Parent GSAM sequential output dataset (PASFLPCB)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the write operation outcome status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the write status is normal (blank/spaces), the record is confirmed as successfully written and the program proceeds to process the associated Pending Authorization Detail (child) records for the same Account ID; if the write status is anything other than normal (blank/spaces), the write is considered failed and error handling is triggered

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Successful Write of Pending Authorization Summary to Parent Output
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to write the Pending Authorization Summary record to the Parent GSAM output dataset, the system must verify whether the write operation completed successfully. A successful write is indicated by a normal (blank/spaces) status, allowing processing to continue to child detail records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to insert the Pending Authorization Summary record into the Parent GSAM sequential output dataset (PASFLPCB) and the write operation has returned a non-normal (non-blank) status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that the Parent GSAM write status is not equal to spaces (indicating a write failure)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system displays a GSAM parent write failure message ('GSAM PARENT FAIL') along with the specific write failure status code and the Key Feedback Area details for diagnostic purposes, then terminates the program abnormally with a return code of 16, halting all further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Failure When Writing Pending Authorization Summary to Parent Output
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the Pending Authorization Summary record cannot be successfully written to the Parent GSAM output dataset, the system must report the failure with diagnostic details and terminate the program abnormally to prevent incomplete or corrupt output data from being produced.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary (parent) record has been successfully read and validated, and the system is ready to retrieve its associated child detail records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program issues a Get-Next-Within-Parent (GNP) retrieval call targeting Pending Authorization Detail records, using an unqualified segment search argument scoped to the current parent summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next available Pending Authorization Detail record belonging to the current parent summary is retrieved for processing; the retrieval is strictly bounded to the current parent and does not cross into detail records of another parent summary

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Retrieval of Pending Authorization Detail Records for Current Parent
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each Pending Authorization Summary (parent) record being processed, the program sequentially retrieves all associated Pending Authorization Detail (child) records one at a time, scoped strictly to the current parent summary record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Get-Next-Within-Parent (GNP) call has been issued for Pending Authorization Detail records under the current parent summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieval is successful, indicated by a blank (spaces) read status, meaning a child detail record was found
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record data is copied into the child segment record area (CHILD-SEG-REC), and the processing state is updated to indicate that more authorization detail records exist (MORE-AUTHS flag set to TRUE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture Pending Authorization Detail Record Data on Successful Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved, its data is captured into the child segment record area and the program flags that more authorization detail records are available for the current parent.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved with a blank (spaces) read status
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program processes the successfully retrieved child detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total summary records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) is incremented by 1, and the total authorization summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is incremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Detail Record Processing Counter on Successful Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved, two running counters are incremented to track the total number of records read and the total number of authorization records processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and its data has been captured into the child segment record area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to insert the Pending Authorization Detail record into the child GSAM output file (PADFLPCB)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the write is successful (status is blank/spaces), the detail record is stored in the child output file and processing continues to the next child record; if the write fails (status is not blank/spaces), the program displays an error message identifying the failure and terminates abnormally with return code 16

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Pending Authorization Detail Record to Child Output File
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each successfully retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record is written to the dedicated child GSAM output file. If the write operation fails for any reason, the program terminates abnormally.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved, captured, written to the child output file, and its counter incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The end-of-child-segment flag (WS-END-OF-CHILD-SEG) has not yet been set to 'Y'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program loops back and issues another Get-Next-Within-Parent (GNP) call to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Detail record for the same parent summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Continue Reading Child Detail Records Until All Are Processed
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved and written, the program loops back to retrieve the next child detail record for the same parent summary, continuing until all child records for the current parent have been processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Get-Next-Within-Parent (GNP) call has been issued for Pending Authorization Detail records under the current parent summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieval returns a 'no more segments' condition (Status = GE), indicating that all child detail records for the current parent have already been retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The end-of-child-segment flag (WS-END-OF-CHILD-SEG) is set to 'Y', which stops the child record retrieval loop and signals the program to return to the parent summary loop to process the next Pending Authorization Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect End of Child Detail Records for Current Parent Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there are no more Pending Authorization Detail records associated with the current parent summary record, the program detects this condition and prepares to move on to the next Pending Authorization Summary record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Get-Next-Within-Parent (GNP) call has been issued for Pending Authorization Detail records under the current parent summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieval returns a status that is neither blank/spaces (successful read) nor 'GE' (no more children), indicating an unexpected error condition
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program displays an error message identifying the GNP call failure along with the key feedback area details for diagnostic purposes, and then terminates abnormally with a return code of 16, stopping all further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Abnormal Termination on Unexpected Error Reading Child Detail Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: If an unexpected error occurs while retrieving Pending Authorization Detail records (any condition other than successful retrieval or normal end-of-children), the program logs the error details and terminates abnormally to prevent incomplete or corrupt data from being written to the output files.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Get-Next-Within-Parent (GNP) call has been issued and all resulting conditions (success, end-of-children, or error) have been fully evaluated and acted upon for the current child detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program completes processing of the current retrieval attempt outcome
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The read status indicator (PAUT-PCB-STATUS) is reset/cleared so that the next Get-Next-Within-Parent call starts with a clean status, preventing any prior status from affecting the next retrieval evaluation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Read Status After Each Child Detail Record Retrieval Attempt
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each child detail record retrieval attempt is fully evaluated and acted upon, the read status is cleared so that it does not carry over and incorrectly influence the evaluation of the next retrieval attempt.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved from the authorization database for the current parent Authorization Summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program prepares to write the detail record to the child output dataset
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record data is moved into the child segment output record area (CHILD-SEG-REC) so that it is ready for insertion into the child GSAM output dataset

all_rules.Rule_Name: Prepare Pending Authorization Detail Record for Child Output
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before writing a Pending Authorization Detail record to the child output dataset, the retrieved detail data must be staged into the child segment output area to ensure the correct record content is written.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been prepared and staged in the child segment output area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program executes the insert operation to write the Pending Authorization Detail record to the child GSAM output dataset (PADFLPCB)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Pending Authorization Detail record is inserted sequentially into the child GSAM output dataset (PADFLPCB), preserving the full detail data for the unload

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Pending Authorization Detail Record to Child Output Dataset
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each successfully retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record must be inserted into the child GSAM sequential output dataset (PADFLPCB) to unload the child segment data as part of the authorization database unload process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An insert operation has been executed to write a Pending Authorization Detail record to the child GSAM output dataset (PADFLPCB)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation completes and the output dataset status indicates success (status is blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Pending Authorization Detail record is confirmed as successfully unloaded to the child output dataset, and the program returns to read the next Pending Authorization Detail record for the current parent

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Successful Write of Pending Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After attempting to write a Pending Authorization Detail record to the child output dataset, the program must confirm the write was successful before continuing to process the next child record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An insert operation has been executed to write a Pending Authorization Detail record to the child GSAM output dataset (PADFLPCB)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation fails and the output dataset status is not blank (indicating an error condition)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program displays the error message 'GSAM PARENT FAIL :' along with the error status, displays the program-level abend message 'DBUNLDGS ABENDING ...', sets the process return code to 16 to signal abnormal termination, and immediately stops all further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Abnormal Termination on Failed Write of Pending Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the write of a Pending Authorization Detail record to the child output dataset fails for any reason, the program must immediately stop all processing, display an error notification, and signal an abnormal termination with a failure return code of 16.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is sequentially reading Pending Authorization Summary records from the authorization database, and a Summary record has been successfully retrieved without any error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Pending Authorization Summary record is confirmed as successfully retrieved (no error condition is present)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Total Records Read Counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) must be incremented by 1, AND the Total Authorization Summary Processed Counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) must be incremented by 1, reflecting that one additional summary record has been read and is being processed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Record Counters on Successful Retrieval of Pending Authorization Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time a Pending Authorization Summary (root/parent) record is successfully retrieved from the database, two running counters must be incremented by 1: the total records read counter and the total authorization summary processed counter. This ensures accurate tracking of how many summary records have been read and processed during the program run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is retrieving Pending Authorization Detail (child) records associated with a specific Pending Authorization Summary (parent) record, and a Detail record has been successfully retrieved without any error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Pending Authorization Detail record is confirmed as successfully retrieved (no error condition is present)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Total Records Read Counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) must be incremented by 1, AND the Total Authorization Summary Processed Counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) must be incremented by 1, reflecting that one additional detail record has been read and processed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Record Counters on Successful Retrieval of Pending Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail (child) record is successfully retrieved from the database under its parent Summary record, the same two running counters must be incremented by 1: the total records read counter and the total authorization summary processed counter. This ensures that both parent and child records contribute equally to the overall processing counts.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is processing Pending Authorization records from the authorization database, which includes both Summary (parent) records and Detail (child) records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Any record — whether a Pending Authorization Summary record or a Pending Authorization Detail record — is successfully retrieved
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Both the Total Records Read Counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) and the Total Authorization Summary Processed Counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) are incremented by 1 for each successful retrieval, regardless of the record type, so that the final counter values represent the combined total of all Summary and Detail records processed during the program run

all_rules.Rule_Name: Shared Counters Apply Uniformly Across Both Summary and Detail Record Types
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program uses the same two counters — Total Records Read (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) and Total Authorization Summary Processed (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) — to track both Pending Authorization Summary records and Pending Authorization Detail records. There are no separate counters for each record type; every successfully retrieved record, regardless of whether it is a parent summary or a child detail, contributes to the same cumulative totals.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has just attempted to read the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database returns a 'No More Records' status (end-of-database signal) indicating that all Pending Authorization Summary root segments have been read
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program identifies that all Pending Authorization Summary records have been fully processed and no further reading of summary records should occur

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect End of Pending Authorization Summary Database
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each attempt to read the next Pending Authorization Summary record, the program evaluates whether all records have been exhausted. When the database signals that no more Pending Authorization Summary root segment records exist, the program recognizes this as the end-of-database condition.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has detected that no more Pending Authorization Summary root segment records exist in the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The end-of-database condition is confirmed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The End-of-Authorization-Database flag (END-OF-AUTHDB) is set to TRUE, formally marking that the entire Pending Authorization Summary database has been processed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set End-of-Authorization-Database Flag Upon Exhaustion of Summary Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the end-of-database condition is detected after reading Pending Authorization Summary records, the program sets a dedicated end-of-authorization-database flag to TRUE to formally record that the authorization summary database has been fully traversed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The End-of-Authorization-Database flag has been set to TRUE after confirming no more Pending Authorization Summary records exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The end-of-database condition is being handled
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The End-of-Root-Segment flag (WS-END-OF-ROOT-SEG) is set to 'Y', which stops the main Pending Authorization Summary processing loop and directs the program to proceed to the file closing step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set End-of-Root-Segment Flag to Halt Summary Record Reading Loop
all_rules.Rule_Description: Alongside setting the end-of-database flag, the program sets a separate end-of-root-segment control flag to 'Y', which directly causes the main processing loop to terminate and prevents any further attempts to read Pending Authorization Summary records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has just read a Pending Authorization Summary record from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database does not return an end-of-database signal, indicating the record was successfully retrieved and more records may still be available
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program proceeds to process the current Pending Authorization Summary record, including validating its Account ID and extracting its associated Pending Authorization Detail child records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Continue Processing When More Pending Authorization Summary Records Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the database read of a Pending Authorization Summary record is successful and no end-of-database condition is signaled, the program continues with processing the current record including its associated detail records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is reading Pending Authorization Detail records for a current parent Pending Authorization Summary record, and a child detail record retrieval has been attempted
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The child Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the database (read status indicates success with no errors)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the 'More Authorizations' indicator to TRUE signaling more child records exist, (2) Increment the total number of summary records read counter by 1, (3) Increment the authorization summary processed count by 1, (4) Copy the retrieved Pending Authorization Detail data into the child segment record, and (5) Write the child Pending Authorization Detail record to the GSAM child detail output file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Successful Retrieval and Processing of Pending Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Detail (child) record is successfully retrieved for the current parent Authorization Summary, the system marks that more authorization details exist, increments the processing counters, and writes the detail record to the GSAM child output file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is iterating through Pending Authorization Detail (child) records for the current parent Pending Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database signals that there are no more Pending Authorization Detail child records available for the current parent Authorization Summary (end-of-children condition is reached)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the End-of-Child-Segment flag to 'Y', and (2) Display a message confirming the end-of-child condition with the flag value, so that the child record reading loop terminates and processing returns to retrieve the next parent Authorization Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detection of No More Pending Authorization Detail Records for Current Parent
all_rules.Rule_Description: When all Pending Authorization Detail records belonging to the current parent Authorization Summary have been processed, the system detects the end-of-children condition and sets a flag to stop reading child records and return to processing the next parent Authorization Summary.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has completed evaluating the result of a Pending Authorization Detail record retrieval attempt (either successfully retrieved or end-of-children detected)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The evaluation of the child record read result is complete for the current iteration
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must reset (clear) the Authorization database read status indicator to its initial empty state before the next child record retrieval is attempted, ensuring no prior read result influences the next iteration

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Child Record Read Status After Each Retrieval Attempt
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each Pending Authorization Detail record retrieval attempt — whether successful or indicating end-of-children — the read status is cleared so that the next child record retrieval starts with a clean state, preventing carry-over of prior read results.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and copied into the child segment record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to write the Pending Authorization Detail record to the GSAM child detail output file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the write is successful, processing continues to the next child record retrieval; if the write fails for any reason, the system must display an error message identifying the failure location and the key feedback area, and terminate the program abnormally with a return code of 16

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Pending Authorization Detail Record to Child Output File
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each successfully retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record must be written to the dedicated GSAM child detail output file. If the write operation fails, the program must terminate abnormally to prevent incomplete or corrupt output data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All Pending Authorization Summary records and their associated Pending Authorization Detail records have been read from the database and written to the respective output files
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program has reached the end of the Pending Authorization database and the main processing loop has completed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program displays the message 'CLOSING THE FILE' to signal successful completion of all record processing, and the program ends normally

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Completion Message Upon Finishing All Record Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once all Pending Authorization Summary and Detail records have been fully processed and written to their respective output files, the program displays a closing completion message to indicate successful end of processing before terminating.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is sequentially reading Pending Authorization Summary records from the database, and a read attempt has just been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The result of the read is neither a successful retrieval (blank status) nor an end-of-database indicator, meaning an unexpected failure has occurred while reading the Pending Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'AUTH SUM GN FAILED' along with the specific failure status returned, and also display the 'KEY FEEDBACK AREA' along with the key feedback value to identify which record caused the failure, then invoke the abnormal termination process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Report Pending Authorization Summary Read Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When reading a Pending Authorization Summary record from the database returns an unexpected result (neither a successful read nor an end-of-database condition), the program must capture and display the failure status and the associated key feedback area before triggering abnormal termination.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is reading Pending Authorization Detail records associated with a specific Pending Authorization Summary record, and a read attempt has just been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The result of the read is neither a successful retrieval (blank status) nor a no-more-children indicator, meaning an unexpected failure has occurred while reading the Pending Authorization Detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'GNP CALL FAILED' along with the specific failure status returned, and also display the 'KFB AREA IN CHILD' along with the key feedback value to identify which child record caused the failure, then invoke the abnormal termination process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Report Pending Authorization Detail Read Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When reading a Pending Authorization Detail (child) record under a parent Summary record returns an unexpected result (neither a successful read nor a no-more-children condition), the program must capture and display the failure status and key feedback area before triggering abnormal termination.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has validated that the Pending Authorization Summary record has a numeric Account ID and is attempting to write it to the parent output file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation to the parent output file does not complete successfully (status is not blank), meaning the Summary record could not be stored in the output
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'GSAM PARENT FAIL' along with the specific failure status returned, and also display the 'KFB AREA IN GSAM' along with the key feedback value to identify the record that failed to write, then invoke the abnormal termination process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Report Parent Summary Output Write Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When writing a Pending Authorization Summary record to the parent output file returns an unsuccessful result, the program must capture and display the failure status and key feedback area before triggering abnormal termination.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has successfully read a Pending Authorization Detail record and is attempting to write it to the child output file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation to the child output file does not complete successfully (status is not blank), meaning the Detail record could not be stored in the output
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'GSAM PARENT FAIL' along with the specific failure status returned, and also display the 'KFB AREA IN GSAM' along with the key feedback value to identify the record that failed to write, then invoke the abnormal termination process

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect and Report Child Detail Output Write Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: When writing a Pending Authorization Detail record to the child output file returns an unsuccessful result, the program must capture and display the failure status and key feedback area before triggering abnormal termination.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A critical failure has been detected during any stage of processing — reading Pending Authorization Summary records, reading Pending Authorization Detail records, writing to the parent output file, or writing to the child output file — and the specific failure details have already been displayed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The abnormal termination process is invoked as a result of any of these critical failures
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'DBUNLDGS ABENDING ...' to announce the abnormal end, set the program return code to 16 to signal a critical failure to the calling environment, and immediately stop all processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Signal Abnormal Program Termination with Return Code 16
all_rules.Rule_Description: When any critical failure occurs during the processing of Pending Authorization Summary or Detail records — whether during reading from the database or writing to output files — the program must announce its abnormal end and communicate a failure signal of 16 to the calling environment before stopping.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is sequentially reading Pending Authorization Summary root records from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Pending Authorization Summary root record is successfully retrieved without any errors
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Summary Records Read Counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) must be incremented by exactly 1 to reflect the newly read root record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Summary Records Read Counter on Successful Root Segment Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time a Pending Authorization Summary root record is successfully retrieved from the database, the total count of summary records read is incremented by 1. This counter tracks the cumulative number of root-level authorization summary records that have been read during the current program execution.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is sequentially reading Pending Authorization Summary root records from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Pending Authorization Summary root record is successfully retrieved without any errors
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary Processed Counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) must be incremented by exactly 1 to reflect the newly processed root record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Summary Records Processed Counter on Successful Root Segment Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time a Pending Authorization Summary root record is successfully retrieved from the database, the total count of authorization summary records processed is incremented by 1. This counter tracks the cumulative number of root-level authorization summary records that have been actively processed during the current program execution, and is shared with the child detail record processing to maintain an overall processing tally.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is processing Pending Authorization Detail child records for a given Pending Authorization Summary parent record, and the shared total records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) holds the current cumulative count of all records read so far (including any previously read summary and detail records)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Pending Authorization Detail child record is successfully retrieved from the database without any retrieval error
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) must be incremented by exactly 1, reflecting the addition of the newly retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record to the cumulative read count

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Total Records Read Counter on Successful Pending Authorization Detail Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail child record is successfully retrieved from the database, the shared total records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) is incremented by 1. This counter tracks all successfully read records across both summary and detail record types.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is processing Pending Authorization Detail child records for a given Pending Authorization Summary parent record, and the shared total authorization records processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) holds the current cumulative count of all authorization records processed so far (including any previously processed summary and detail records), and the total records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) has already been incremented for this same successfully retrieved detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Pending Authorization Detail child record is successfully retrieved from the database without any retrieval error
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total authorization records processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) must be incremented by exactly 1, reflecting the addition of the newly retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record to the cumulative processed count

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Total Records Processed Counter on Successful Pending Authorization Detail Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail child record is successfully retrieved from the database, the shared total authorization records processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is incremented by 1. This counter tracks all successfully processed authorization records across both summary and detail record types.

description:
DBUNLDGS is a batch IMS program that unloads Pending Authorization data from an IMS database by reading both the root (summary) and child (detail) segments, then writing them to GSAM output files for archival or downstream processing purposes. The program iterates through all Pending Authorization Summary root segments and their associated Detail child segments, inserting each into separate GSAM sequential output datasets. It is a Main/Driver program, as it contains the primary ENTRY point 'DLITCBL' and drives all processing logic directly.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch (IMS/DLI) - **Database Access**: IMS - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Display program start banner and capture the current date and Julian date (YYDDD) to log processing context. 2: Read Pending Authorization Summary (Root Segment) - Sequentially retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record (root segment PAUTSUM0) from the IMS database using an unqualified Get-Next (GN) call. 3: Validate Account ID - Check that the Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) retrieved from the Pending Authorization Summary is numeric before proceeding with further processing. 4: Write Pending Authorization Summary to Output (Parent GSAM) - Insert the retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record into the parent GSAM sequential output dataset (PASFLPCB) to unload the root segment data. 5: Read Pending Authorization Detail (Child Segment) - Sequentially retrieve all child Pending Authorization Detail records (child segment PAUTDTL1) associated with the current root segment using an unqualified Get-Next-within-Parent (GNP) call. 6: Write Pending Authorization Detail to Output (Child GSAM) - Insert each retrieved Pending Authorization Detail record into the child GSAM sequential output dataset (PADFLPCB) to unload the child segment data. 7: Track Summary and Detail Record Counts - Increment counters for the number of summary (root) records read and the number of detail (child) records read during processing. 8: Detect End of Authorization Summary Database - Identify when all Pending Authorization Summary root segments have been processed (IMS status 'GB') and set the end-of-database flag to stop further reading. 9: Detect End of Child Segments for Current Parent - Identify when there are no more Pending Authorization Detail child segments for the current parent (IMS status 'GE') and set the end-of-child flag to move to the next root segment. 10: Close Output Files and Display Completion - Display a closing message upon completion of all record processing before the program ends. 11: Abnormal Termination Handling - Display an error message and set a return code of 16 to signal abnormal program termination when a critical IMS database call fails.
